title: Callsign-only auth with signed session tokens
description: Implement callsign-only authentication: a player claims a unique callsign, the server creates the player, and issues an HMAC-signed session token required for all gameplay. No passwords anywhere.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/callsigns {callsign} claims a callsign (3-16 chars, alphanumeric + dash, case-insensitive uniqueness); success returns {callsign, token, playerId, homeSystemId} and creates the player with starter ship
Claims for an existing callsign return 409 {code:'callsign-taken'}
Session token = HMAC-signed compact payload {playerId, systemId?, exp} signed with SESSION_SECRET; stored hash (sha256) in sessions table, raw token never stored or logged
GET /api/session with Bearer token returns the player profile; missing/invalid/expired token returns 401 with structured error
WS handshake auth{token} validates the same way; unauthenticated gameplay messages rejected with {code:'unauthenticated'}
API tests (fastify inject): claim, duplicate claim, valid session, expired session (fake clock), invalid signature, WS auth path

steps.details: src/server/routes/callsigns.ts: validate with shared zod schema; repository.createPlayer (unique callsign constraint → catch CallsignTakenError → 409); getOrCreateStarterShip (class 'scout'); issue token; insert sessions row (token_hash, player_id, expires_at = now + 7d).

src/server/auth/token.ts: sign(payload) / verify(token) using node:crypto HMAC-SHA256 with SESSION_SECRET; base64url encoding; exp check with 30 s clock-skew tolerance; constant-time compare for the MAC. Never log tokens or SESSION_SECRET.

GET /api/session: Authorization: Bearer <token> → verify signature + exp → look up token_hash in sessions (401 if absent) → return {callsign, credits, homeSystemId, shipId}. WS: auth message in handshake uses the same verify + lookup.
Connection state machine from TASK-9: after hello-ok, require auth before join_system; store playerId on the connection; attach to all subsequent message handling.
API + WS integration tests covering every acceptance criterion; expired-session test injects a fake clock. Run npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test.

technicalNotes: Callsign re-claim is impossible (409 forever); the only session invalidation path is expiry — TASK-66 adds revocation.
Home system = a seeded system chosen from the galaxy (star index derived from player id) so every player has a defined spawn.
